subject: Temporary payment agreement for small supplier onboarding
messages:
From: Ari Patel <ari@microvendor.io>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Small-supplier onboarding / invoice-first ask

Hi Sergio,

Thanks again for the demo last week. MicroVendor is excited to move forward with the pilot — small volume to start (monthly spend expected to be under $3k). Our finance team prefers invoicing on net-30 rather than going through a purchase order (we're a tiny shop and PO cycles would delay delivery by weeks).

Could Redwood accept an invoice-first onboarding for MicroVendor for the first 90 days while we complete the vendor portal setup? We can provide W9, insurance cert, and an initial sample invoice immediately. If helpful, I attached our W9.

Happy to sign any temporary payment agreement you need. Timeline: we'd like to start the trial on the 20th.

Best,
Ari
VP Ops, MicroVendor Inc.
ari@microvendor.io
Attachment: microvendor_w9.pdf (pdf)

Subject: Re: Small-supplier onboarding / invoice-first ask

Ari — thanks for the clear note and the W9. Looping in Marissa (AE) and Karthik from procurement to route this.

Marissa / Karthik — MicroVendor is asking for an invoice-first onboarding path for the first 90 days while they finish vendor portal intake. They are small ($~3k/mo anticipated) and timeboxed to a pilot starting 20 Sep. Ari attached W9; I added a very short Temporary Payment Agreement (TPA) draft to speed approval. The key asks from their side: no PO required for pilot invoices, net-30, Redwood to accept emailed invoices to finance@redwood.ai.

Questions for procurement/finance: is there an established temporary path for < $5k/mo vendors? If so, what evidence/controls do we need to collect (insurance/W9/reference/limit on total commit)? If not, what would you need to sign off quickly so we don't miss their start date?

I attached the TPA (lightweight, ~2 clauses) — happy to iterate.

Sergio Alvarez
Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Thanks for flagging this, Sergio. Short answer: procurement has a small-vendor temporary path but it requires a couple of guardrails.

What I need to approve the no-PO temporary route:
- Completed vendor intake docs (W9 confirmed).
- Single-invoice cap or rolling monthly cap (suggest cap <= $5,000/month for the pilot).
- Signed Temporary Payment Agreement with specific payment address and invoice submission address.
- Confirmation that MicroVendor will be added to the "small-supplier allowlist" and that AM/Finance own the expiration (90 days default).

If those items are in place, procurement will sign off; we also require Finance copy (cc below) to confirm cashflow/GL coding. If this is urgent, we can do a discretionary approval if AM commits to the cap and we store the signed TPA in the procurement folder.

I made two redlines to the TPA (kept inline comments in the draft). If we get the doc signed and W9 uploaded, procurement can generate an internal waiver.

Karthik
Procurement
Redwood Inference

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Small-supplier onboarding / invoice-first ask — finance sign-off

Team — reviewed the intake and the proposed controls. Finance approves a temporary invoice-first flow subject to the following conditions:
1) Cap set at $5,000/month; cumulative cap for 90 days not to exceed $15,000.
2) Signed Temporary Payment Agreement (attached) filed in procurement.
3) MicroVendor must submit first invoice with remit instructions and attach the W9.
4) Invoices go to finance@redwood.ai with AM in cc; payment will be net-30.
5) Auto-escalation: if invoices hit 80% of the monthly cap two months in a row, AM must pause and notify procurement.

I generated a DocuSign packet for the TPA and shared it with Ari (link below). Once signed we can create the internal waiver and add MicroVendor to the small-supplier allowlist.

DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/TPA/MicroVendor/12345
Internal procurement record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

Logan Wright
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
